Alex: Quick poll for the weekend watercooler — if your favorite model were a snack, what would it be? I’ll start: my Claude-3 is definitely sourdough toast that over-explains toppings. 😂
Maya: GPT-4o = espresso shot. jittery but gets things done :coffee:
Sam: Cookies for GPTs, bagels for LLaMAs. voting cookie 🍪
Jules: Mine's a fortune cookie. always full of ambiguous guidance.
Sophia: Also who’s bringing cookies? I can bring choc chip on Friday. @Jen you in?
Jen: Yep! Local bakery box coming :yum:
Alex: Bonus prompt confession: I once asked a model to write my grocery list in iambic pentameter. no regrets.
Chris: Same — told it to format my todo as a pirate map. 'X marks the laundry'
Lunch-bot: Poll created: Cookies / Bagels / Sourdough. Vote by replying with your choice.
Maya: Cookies :cookie:
Sam: bagels :bagel:
Jules: sourdough :bread:
Alex: PSA: don't leave food at desks, kitchen rules still apply :fridge:
Jen: Also curious: if a model filed HR, would it submit a bug report or a sonnet? :thinking:
Sophia: Sonnet. 100% would write a sonnet.
Noodle-bot: Reaction summary — Cookies x2, Bagels x1, Sourdough x1, Coffee x1, LOL x4
Alex: Ok cookies it is. Friday 3pm kitchen. Optional: prompt-themed toppings (system prompt sprinkles) :sparkles:
